compiled_state.description:
## What
Create `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/phase1-gate-attestation.md` — the attestation contract file that documents the completeness attestation field for the Phase 1 Gate.

## File path
`plugins/dso/docs/contracts/phase1-gate-attestation.md`

## Required sections (must be present — tested by test-brainstorm-attestation-contract.sh)
1. `## Purpose` — describes the completeness attestation sub-step and its role in blocking self-attestation bypass
2. `## Signal Name` — `PHASE1_GATE_ATTESTATION` or `completeness_attestation` field name
3. `## Allowed Values` — exactly two: `exhausted` (all gap questions resolved; blocking_for answered) and `open` (unresolved questions remain; list of question entries with blocking_for fields)
4. `## Exhausted State` — definition: all questions resolved; every gap question has a blocking_for that was answered; gate may proceed to Phase 2
5. `## Open State` — definition: list of unresolved questions; each entry contains question text and `blocking_for: <phase>` field; gate CANNOT return passed while attestation is open
6. `## Blocking Semantics` — Phase 1 Gate CANNOT return passed without attestation field being present; missing or absent attestation field = non-passing signal
7. `## META_QUESTION Routing` — documents that when blocking_for resolves to brainstorm itself (meta-question about the brainstorm process), emit META_QUESTION signal rather than REPLAN_ESCALATE; references decision-id-format.md and META_QUESTION signal contract (from story 893a-d0d3)
8. `## PRECONDITIONS Entry` — documents that gate exit writes a PRECONDITIONS decisions_log entry with affects_fields: [workflow_completion_checklist]; explains why (100% sampler routing per SC2)
9. `## Emitter` — `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` Phase 1 Gate

## Dependencies
This contract is referenced by SKILL.md Phase 1 Gate after Task 5 is complete. The META_QUESTION signal contract and decision-id-format.md (from 893a-d0d3) are referenced by path only — this file does not need to redefine those contracts.

## Acceptance criteria for this task
- File exists at the specified path
- All 9 sections present with correct heading names
- test-brainstorm-attestation-contract.sh passes after this task
